name: product-engineer
description: Your agent ships code. product-engineer makes it ship outcomes. Four skills: the seven rules, the customer block alone, done means observed, and release notes.

interface.shortDescription: Plain-language customer block in every commit, and done means observed
interface.longDescription: Makes a coding agent restate work as a customer outcome, write a plain-language "For the customer" block in every commit and pull request, report what it observed or could not check, name what it deliberately did not build, and never print a number it did not count.
defaultPrompt: Commit this change and write the For the customer block.
Check that my pull request description explains the change to a customer.
